errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts, try again in {{seconds}} s
errors.rateLimitedLater: Too many attempts, try again in a moment
errors.rateLimitedSr: Too many attempts. The form unlocks in {{seconds}} seconds.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Sign in to manage your site.
login.invalid: That login and password don't match an account.
login.noticeTotpExpired: The sign-in took too long, so it was cancelled. Enter your password again.

totp.title: Two-factor code
totp.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
totp.codeHint: Codes change every 30 seconds. Pasting works too.
totp.invalid: That code is wrong or has expired. Wait for the next code and try again.

change.title: Change your password
change.subtitle: Enter your current password, then the new one.
change.subtitleForced: Your account needs a new password before you continue. Enter the one-time password you were given, then choose your own.

policy.text: At least 12 characters and at most 1024 bytes. A passphrase of several words is easy to remember and hard to guess.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your login or e-mail address and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account matches, a link to choose a new password is on its way to the account's e-mail address. The link works once, for one hour.
forgot.sentHint: Nothing arrived? Check your spam folder, or ask an administrator.
forgot.mailUnavailable: Password reset by e-mail is not set up on this site; ask an administrator

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Pick a password you don't use anywhere else.
reset.doneBody: Sign in with your new password. Every other session of this account was signed out.
reset.expired: This link is invalid or has expired
reset.expiredBody: Reset links work once, for one hour. Ask for a new one.
